Class ConditionExpression

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.expression.FilterExpression
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.expression.ConditionExpression
public class ConditionExpression extends FilterExpression
A FilterExpression subtype that represents a DynamoDB condition expression.

This is a type-safe alias: it inherits all builder methods from FilterExpression but is accepted by APIs that require a condition expression (e.g., put, update, delete) rather than a filter expression (e.g., query, scan).
